dogecoin.text: $DOGE just SMASHING above the buy signal of 28 sats. The altseason indicator itself. Already had a bag of this so likely wont add to it, but now I have a metric that will tell me when to close out if it doesnt do what DOGE loves to do and go to 80 sats. Stop set at 25 sats.

$DOGE I can't help but wonder if that 2 sat "pump" was @elonmusk related haha. Added another closed trade into my new Doge stablecoin. Patiently waiting for the inevitable. The depth chart is downright comical though.
@CarpeNoctom @ledgerstatus When is $DOGE going to DOGE? Such steady, much flat.

Overall, happy with how it played out. Having a clear sell buy and sell signal is what I'm aiming for and I had both. It also helps me not marry my bags which has been a past and present problem.  I think I already love $DOGE and it hasn't moved yet haha

$DOGE technically there was a sell signal that popped up at 26 sats, but as the trend never really formed, there was no trend to break so I held for the stop loss which never tripped. Back up to 28 sats which it seems to be glued to.  Little more thinking that planned though.
I mean everyone is panicing except $DOGE which is calmly having its highest BTC gain in weeks!

portfolio was mostly in $BTC and $DOGE which interestingly enough, barely moved relative to BTC. As soon as the market finds some stability, I will resume my trading and logging. Looking back, I'm pleased with the month.
